target.label: yt.flow system-level pre-release trace (Epics 1-4, all stories done)

tests.cases: 245+ (spot-counted, not exhaustively enumerated; +15 added during remediation)

recommendations.action: Rescope SYS-INT-012 with Dev/Architecture — adopt Alembic (then write the roundtrip test) or formally drop the requirement, since create_all() is the current migration strategy and no Alembic tooling exists to test
Adopt @pytest.mark.p0-p3 tagging so Exit Criteria can be enforced via pytest -m instead of manual bucketing against this matrix

Consider whether the duplicate SYS-INT-004 coverage across test_runs.py and test_stages.py should be consolidated — kept as-is for now since test_stages.py's version additionally proves the checkpoint is untouched

critical_findings_fixed_during_this_trac: pipeline/nodes/__init__.py wired Story 1.4 stub functions (no-ops) instead of the real, already-implemented, already-unit-tested scenario/image/tts/subtitle nodes — every real run would produce zero scenes and fail at the video stage. Fixed by wiring the real node functions into STAGE_NODES.

GET /runs/{id}/artifact (video download, FR-26) looked for output.mp4 but video_node (and every other consumer) has always used video.mp4 — every completed run's download 404'd unconditionally. Fixed the filename.
run_service.py's generic exception handler hardcoded stage='unknown' for every node failure, violating FR-13. Fixed by parsing LangGraph's PEP 678 exception note to surface the real failing node.
run_service.py's _trace_cm() swallowed Langfuse span setup/teardown exceptions with zero logging, violating AD-10's 'log the error and continue' requirement. Added logger.warning calls.

tests/api/test_workspace_files.py claimed [verify-existing] path-traversal coverage (SYS-INT-009, R-006 security) that did not exist — zero negative-path tests were present. Added 4 traversal/symlink/absolute-path tests (all pass — Starlette's StaticFiles already blocks them by construction).

stub_profile test fixture was missing a 5th seam (Langfuse Prompt Hub fetch in scenario_node) — the 'offline' B-2 stub-profile smoke test was never actually offline for this path, silently producing zero scenes via AD-10's error-swallowing. Added fake_get_prompt seam.
